title: Vityo
goal: Deliver Vityo as an independent, truthful developer environment and AI-native Agent Client.
description: The IDE product line owns editing, workbench, language and execution services, Agent collaboration UI, external-agent hosting, and desktop delivery; it never owns Coding Agent runtime implementation.

title: Vityo Coding Agent
goal: Deliver Vityo Coding Agent as an independent, secure, model-neutral coding runtime that collaborates with IDEs through open protocols.
description: The Coding Agent product line owns model orchestration, context selection, tools, policy, coding loops, durable sessions, and multi-agent execution; it never imports Vityo or Flutter implementation.
